name: clementreiffers/hotel-scraping
what_it_holds: Python/Selenium bots scraping four hotel sites — hotels.com, booking.com, trivago.fr, kayak.fr — for name, address, price, star rating, GPS, capacity, room count, one CSV per site. No data committed to the repo; the tool must be run to produce data. French-locale focus (trivago.fr, kayak.fr).
why_useful: A working, non-Airbnb scraper that explicitly covers two metasearch engines (trivago, Kayak) alongside two OTAs, so if a human decides scraping non-Airbnb metasearch pages is in-bounds, this is a ready template for building a hotel-price comparator panel.
themes: Google Hotel Ads / Google Travel price datasets and scrapers; hotel metasearch price panels
why_all: A working, non-Airbnb scraper that explicitly covers two metasearch engines (trivago, Kayak) alongside two OTAs, so if a human decides scraping non-Airbnb metasearch pages is in-bounds, this is a ready template for building a hotel-price comparator panel.

name: seanbabalala/hotelrate-crawl (hotelrate-mcp)
what_it_holds: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for live, on-demand hotel price comparison across Trip.com, Booking.com, Agoda, and Google Hotels (Playwright-based real-time crawling with session persistence for the first three; Google Hotels support is real-time-only). No data committed; ships a demo mode returning synthetic data and a live mode that scrapes. README explicitly notes 20-40% price variance for the same room across OTAs.
why_useful: One of very few repos that names 'Google Hotels' explicitly as a live price source alongside major OTAs; could in principle be adapted (by a human, not run by an agent) into a repeated snapshot panel of Google Hotels-displayed rates for named markets/dates as an ex-Airbnb ADR cross-check.
themes: Google Hotel Ads / Google Travel price datasets and scrapers; hotel metasearch price panels
why_all: One of very few repos that names 'Google Hotels' explicitly as a live price source alongside major OTAs; could in principle be adapted (by a human, not run by an agent) into a repeated snapshot panel of Google Hotels-displayed rates for named markets/dates as an ex-Airbnb ADR cross-check.

name: Algorithmic-learning-Project (Expedia recommendations)
what_it_holds: Code applying the 2013 Kaggle 'Expedia Hotel Recommendations' dataset (~37M click/booking search-result rows with search date, check-in/out dates, destination, price bucket, is_booking flag) via the Kaggle API; no data files committed to the repo itself.
why_useful: The underlying Expedia dataset (external, on Kaggle) has real booking-vs-click records with implicit lead time (date_time of search vs. srch_ci check-in date) that could proxy OTA booking-window/lead-time distributions for gap #3, but this repo itself is just a thin ML exercise with no committed data and no method for point-in-time refresh.
size_hint: not committed; external Kaggle dataset is ~37M rows / ~4GB
themes: Hotel booking demand datasets (Antonio Almeida Nunes and successors), hotel PMS datasets, revenue-management datasets with cancellations and lead times

name: shrican/expedia-bigdata-analysis
what_it_holds: Hadoop/MapReduce big-data analysis project built on the Kaggle 'Expedia Hotel Recommendations' (ICDM 2013 / 2016 competition) dataset -- user search sessions, destination clusters, and click/booking events across ~37M training rows in the original Kaggle release. Dataset is referenced/pulled from Kaggle, not committed (too large for git); repo holds the Hadoop jobs/analysis code only.
why_useful: Expedia search-and-book session data is a large real dataset on a directly competing OTA's demand patterns (destination popularity, booking-vs-click conversion, seasonality) -- usable as a competitor-volume proxy or as a methodology template for building an Airbnb-analogous demand model, responsive to gap #9.
license: Not stated; code repo appears unlicensed
themes: Kaggle competitions and datasets on travel demand forecasting mirrored on GitHub (Expedia, Trivago, Booking, Airbnb new-user bookings, hotel demand)
